content: Gradle 8.14's built-in jacoco plugin defaults toolVersion to 0.8.13 (confirmed in Gradle source JacocoPlugin.java DEFAULT_JACOCO_VERSION). Latest standalone JaCoCo release is 0.8.15 (2026-06-05, GitHub releases API), supports current JDKs including 17. Override via jacoco { toolVersion = "0.8.15" }.
